data.bottom_line: Winter finally arrived and brought 15-24 inches of snow over the last week. This snow has allowed lots of folks to get out, and it also means that avalanche season is here. Even small slides can cause trauma if they sweep you over rocks and stumps. Avalanches are most likely on slopes with recent wind loading and wind drifts. Grassy, low-angle slopes offer an excellent opportunity for early-season turns.
